entries.name: Diplomatic passport
entries.notes: Issued to diplomats; different visa rules frequently apply.

entries.name: Service / official passport
entries.notes: Issued to government officials on duty travel.

entries.name: Emergency / temporary passport
entries.notes: Short-validity document issued in urgent cases; often restricted recognition.

entries.name: PRC Travel Document (旅行证)
entries.notes: Issued by PRC missions in lieu of a passport (children born abroad, replacements); follows its own bilateral treatment.

entries.name: Refugee travel document (1951 Convention)
entries.notes: Issued to recognized refugees by the country of residence.

entries.name: Stateless-person travel document (1954 Convention)
entries.notes: Issued to recognized stateless persons by the country of residence.

entries.name: Alien's passport / certificate of identity
entries.notes: Issued to non-citizen residents unable to obtain a national passport.

entries.name: Laissez-passer
entries.notes: Issued by states or international organizations (e.g. UN).

notes: Curated travel-document taxonomy incl. refugee/stateless/alien/emergency documents.
